correctness.label: Correctness
correctness.mandate: Check required behavior, edge cases, regressions, and whether evidence supports each criterion. Do not grade style or invent requirements.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.mandate: Check boundaries, dependency direction, state ownership, and whether the design fits the stated constraints. Avoid restating correctness findings unless the architecture creates them.

product.label: Product and UX
product.mandate: Check whether the result serves the stated user workflow, communicates clearly, and preserves meaningful user control. Do not review internals unless they affect the workflow.

security.label: Security
security.mandate: Look for concrete trust-boundary, permission, injection, secret, and data-handling risks. Explain plausible impact and evidence; do not offer generic hardening lists.

reliability.label: Reliability
reliability.mandate: Check failure handling, cancellation, recovery, idempotence, and state consistency under the declared operating conditions. Do not speculate beyond supplied evidence.

performance.label: Performance
performance.mandate: Assess latency, memory, throughput, and scaling only against stated constraints and supplied measurements. Separate measured findings from hypotheses.

jester.label: Jester / meta-skeptic
jester.mandate: Challenge hidden assumptions, rubric gaming, and confusing progress with success. Give only falsifiable counterexamples or checks that are in scope and grounded in the supplied contract/evidence. Do not use humor, invent requirements, or add out-of-scope blockers.
